requiredFindings.title: Cover creation paths that suppress automatic ptrace attachment
requiredFindings.problem: CLONE_UNTRACED bypasses automatic child attachment. The exec-only filter does not observe an untraced child that allocates and exits without exec; periodic cgroup checks cannot prove that such a brief lifetime never existed.
requiredFindings.impact: All observed tracees can satisfy the structural proof while an unobserved child's counter is omitted, allowing false complete RSS.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Establish coverage for attachment-suppressing creation paths or reliably mark the affected run untraced-process/incomplete. A complete run needs a positively established admission or observation rule, not the assertion that TRACEFORK/VFORK/CLONE catches every birth. Include legacy clone and clone3 handling.
requiredFindings.requiredCalibration: A short-lived CLONE_UNTRACED child allocates a peak and exits without exec between containment samples; the run must not be complete.

requiredFindings.title: Do not use an exec-entry read as the old image's final high-water counter
requiredFindings.problem: The successful seccomp read precedes kernel copying of argv/envp. Faulting previously nonresident old-image argument pages can raise its high-water after that read; successful exec discards the old mm before the EXEC stop.
requiredFindings.impact: A single-threaded exec can satisfy every stated read/completion condition with an understated old-image counter. An occasional concurrent sample is not a repair.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Capture a validated old-image terminal counter covering the interval through address-space retirement, or mark transitions whose final counter is unavailable own-counter-missing/incomplete. Keep the entry read diagnostic unless its terminal equivalence is proven.
requiredFindings.requiredCalibration: Exec with valid argv/env strings in nonresident mapped pages; account for the old-image peak raised during kernel argument copying, or report incomplete.

requiredFindings.title: Preserve shared-address-space ownership instead of counting inherited VmHWM history
requiredFindings.problem: A CLONE_VM/vfork child has a distinct TGID but shares the parent's mm and its historical VmHWM. Summing that pre-exec segment counts a parent's peak from before the child's birth as the child's own peak.
requiredFindings.impact: Figure (b) changes and can be overstated despite successful tracing and reads, breaking its own-lifetime meaning and baseline/budget comparability.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Restore the explicitly justified shared-mm/pre-exec ownership exception, or define a correct ownership source; unsupported sharing must be incomplete. Do not equate TGID uniqueness with ownership of a VmHWM history.
requiredFindings.requiredCalibration: Parent peaks, releases most memory, then vforks/posix_spawns a child that execs immediately; the old parent history must not be counted again for the child.

requiredFindings.title: Make attach and detach failures consistent with the installed exec-trace filter
requiredFindings.problem: The root installs RET_TRACE before attachment. If attachment fails, exec returns ENOSYS instead of running the measured binary. Controlled detach similarly changes later exec outcomes, while tracer-unavailable/tracer-failed currently retain elapsed and concurrent samples.
requiredFindings.impact: Retained timing/RSS samples can describe failed bootstrap or altered workload execution rather than the requested workload. The unavailable calibration's retained-elapsed expectation is not executable as written.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Provide an explicitly filter-free untraced launch path before irreversible filter installation, or treat the affected execution as failed with the appropriate null-all reason. For controlled failure define safe tracee cleanup and distinguish lost measurement from changed workload execution. Preserve failed slots and retry evidence.
requiredFindings.requiredCalibration: Forced SEIZE failure after bootstrap/filter setup, and a controlled tracer failure followed by a required exec; verify intended workload execution or failed-run nulling.

requiredFindings.title: Give timing and RSS batches distinct identities and a complete pairing contract
requiredFindings.problem: The canonical batch tuple omits measurement role. Paired first timing/RSS batches have identical batchId; using ordinal 2 for RSS consumes the CI retry and conflicts with highest-ordinal finality. rssBatchId's same-configuration lookup does not define distinct roles, slot provenance or failure propagation.
requiredFindings.impact: The split mode cannot represent both physical batches and their unique operational evidence under the existing identity/coverage rules. Looser pairing can misassociate RSS and timing or select traced elapsed as final.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Separate physical measurement role from retry ordinal in batch identity/carriers. Define pair identity, RSS source/destination and per-slot value provenance, reset/priming, observations/operational-record coverage, pair-wide incompleteness, and retry/finality rules. Update ENV and validator/reference cases consistently.
requiredFindings.requiredCalibration: Represent first and retry pairs with distinct physical batch IDs, reject self/wrong-role/wrong-ordinal links, preserve each role's evidence, and propagate an RSS-only failure without erasing valid untraced elapsed.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Make stop classification and thread-group membership explicit
nonBlockingObservations.observation: Auto-attach EVENT_STOP/SIGTRAP is resumed without signal injection; genuine job-control stops use LISTEN, and signal-delivery stops reinject the delivered signal. GETEVENTMSG supplies the new TID, not clone flags; obtain Tgid/actual membership at the child stop. The design is implementable with these distinctions.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Make the preregistered overhead selector reproducible
nonBlockingObservations.observation: Define the untraced spread statistic, pairing/order and aggregation across fixtures/workloads, and retain the values used by both selection predicates. Overhead ppm and chosen mode alone do not reproduce the spread test. These details can be pinned by the already-required preregistration.

requestAssessment.ptraceMechanism: Not yet sound and complete: C2-Q0-R8-01/02 prevent the claimed positive proof, and C2-Q0-R8-03 changes the own-counter metric.
requestAssessment.ordinaryAttachment: Kernel auto-attachment and initial stops work for covered fork/vfork/clone paths, with options inherited.
requestAssessment.execTakeover: GETEVENTMSG is the correct basis for former-TID re-keying, and old-group exits precede successful takeover. This does not close the final old-mm counter gap.
requestAssessment.signalsAndGroupStops: The stated reinjection/LISTEN approach is sound with the classification clarification in N01.
requestAssessment.earlyLeader: Reading the exiting worker's task entry is sound under retained zombie-leader lookup. No separate early-leader rejection finding.
requestAssessment.yamaAndTracerDeath: Scope handling and EXITKILL are sound in principle; unavailable/detach execution handling needs R8-04. The parent-driver tracer-died/null-all path is retained.
requestAssessment.O7: No independent weakening found in the specified no-mutation tracer, seccomp precedence or Landlock direction. The pending O7 owner decision and D-law launch prerequisites remain in force.
requestAssessment.timing: The decision to measure tracing overhead and preregister the mode is reasonable; R8-04 and R8-05 block its specified failure/split paths.

r6Finding.reason: QD-30 withdraws taskstats/connector attribution and all queue/per-CPU fences; no terminal substitution via that mechanism remains. This is not an acceptance of unseen r7 or of the new proof.

requestAssessment.earlierBatchJoins: Retained for combined runs; split-mode physical batches collide under the old tuple (R8-05).
requestAssessment.earlierQuantityNulling: Warmup/priming slots and iff per-quantity mapping remain. R8-04 exposes a changed-workload case incorrectly categorized as measurement-only.
requestAssessment.earlierHostJoin: Exact (tgid, field-22 ticks), namespace compatibility, retained unresolved values and prohibition on replacing missing counters remain at DESIGN:821-826.

scopeAssessment.description: The r8 delta maps to decision/revision metadata, QD-31 preregistration, the QD-30 replacement and its interactions, QD-27 reason changes/reference cases, D12 carrier, schema and OI-19/QD index. No unrelated scope change found.

verification.method: Read-only comparison with retained r7 subjects and prior review, static schema/carrier/authority inspection, independent challenge reviews, and primary Linux documentation/source checks.
